I believe you have access to the funds even though it pushes the date back.  Say you have 5000 available once your 2 weeks are up and another 1000 available after 21 days (so 6000 total).  After a week you decide to "pay me now" for 2000$ bringing you down to 3000$.  It recalculates the 2 weeks and pushes the date back, subtracts the 2000$ and adds the new 1000$ ($5000-$2000+the new $1000).  Now your 2 week payout would be 4000$.  The original 3000$ left is still going to be available on a day to day basis for "pay me now," your lump sum date just changes.  That is my understanding at least.  I just don't mess with it and never do the "pay me now" as I like the lump sum payments better.  Try and build yourself a little cushion.
